requisitions.description: Every request to hire, newest first. A requisition is decided in the approval requests; once approved it takes job openings, and it is filled when its headcount is hired.
requisitions.hint: It goes for approval. Once approved, job openings can be added to it.
requisitions.title: Job title
requisitions.decidedWhere: Approving or rejecting it happens in the approval requests.

confirm.cancel: Cancel this requisition? A pending one withdraws its approval request.
confirm.close: Close this requisition? It stops hiring, whoever is hired so far.

problems.budget: The budget's upper end is below its lower end.

openings.title: Job openings
openings.description: Every job opening, newest first. An opening is added from its approved requisition and opens on its own page, with its applicants on a board by stage.
openings.hint: The advert for this requisition. Leave the title empty to use the requisition's.
openings.afterApproval: Openings can be added once the requisition is approved.
openings.notFound: This job opening does not exist.

candidates.title: Candidate
candidates.description: Every candidate on file, newest first. Candidates never hired are deleted with their CVs after the retention period.
candidates.name: Name
candidates.eraseConfirm: Erase {name} and everything about them, CVs included? This is for a request to be forgotten and cannot be undone. An employee record made from them stays.
candidates.consented: Agreed to their data being kept on {date}

applications.title: Applications
applications.rejectHint: The application ends. The reason is kept on it.
applications.withdrawHint: The candidate withdrew; the application ends.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.notified: Each interviewer is told, and only they can score the interview.

offers.title: Offers
offers.hint: It goes to the requisition's approval before it is made, and moves the application to the offer stage.
offers.payHint: Becomes the employee's pay when they are hired.
offers.noPayComponents: Pay components are not available to this account; the offer carries its terms only.
offers.waitingCandidate: The offer is approved. Record the candidate's answer when they give it.
offers.acceptConfirm: Record that the candidate accepted this offer? They can then be hired.
offers.declineConfirm: Record that the candidate declined this offer?

hire.title: Hire
hire.hint: The candidate becomes an employee from what is already known: their name, phone and email, the requisition's unit, position, grade, manager and employment type, and the offer's start date and pay.
hire.alreadyEmployee: This candidate is already an employee and cannot be hired again. Record the move on their file as a transfer or a promotion.
hire.afterwards: Their file opens with the onboarding tasks; anything else is completed there.
hire.needsPermission: Hiring needs the permission to add employees.

stages.description: The stages an application moves through. Add and order the open ones; offer, hired, rejected and withdrawn are fixed and reached only by their own action.

mine.description: Open jobs you can apply to, your applications, the requisitions you file as a hiring manager, and the interviews you conduct.
mine.applyHint: HR sees your name and contact details from your file.
mine.noJobs: No open jobs at the moment.
mine.noApplications: You have not applied to any job.
mine.requisitionsHint: As a hiring manager, ask to hire for your team.
